title: Profile
description: Manage your personal information, security, preferences, and integrations.
name: Name
phone_verification_unavailable: WhatsApp confirmation unavailable right now — try again later.
verification_description: We sent a code to {{target}}. Enter it below to confirm.
phone_dialog_desc: Enter your mobile phone number with area code to receive notifications and security codes via WhatsApp.
security_desc: Update your access password periodically to keep your account safe.
userconfig_desc_theme: Select your preferred theme for the application interface.
userconfig_desc_language: Select your preferred display language for the system interface.
userconfig_desc_tour: Would you like to see the tutorial again?
passwordMin: Password must have at least 8 characters
passwordRequirements: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, number and special character
privacy_data_desc: Manage and export data associated with your account in compliance with privacy laws.
export_my_data_desc: Download a machine-readable JSON copy of all your registered data.
export_success: Your data has been exported successfully.
danger_zone_desc: Irreversible actions that permanently affect your account.
delete_my_account_desc: Deleting your account is permanent and will remove all your data and permissions. This action cannot be undone.
delete_account_warning: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action is irreversible and all your data will be permanently deleted.
agent_permissions_description: Manage which tools the AI assistant is allowed to execute on your behalf.
noToolsAvailable: No tools available for your role
toolAllowedSuccess: AI access to the tool allowed
toolRevokedSuccess: AI access to the tool revoked
tool_list_api_keys: Lists your API keys (the secret is never shown).
tool_generate_invite: Generates a signup invite for an email.
tool_describe_cms_schema: Describes the CMS collections and fields.
tool_set_feature_flag_roles: Sets which roles a feature flag applies to.
tool_toggle_feature_flag: Turns a feature flag on or off.
tool_describe_page_builder: Describes the blocks available on a customizable page.
tool_get_role_route_access: Reads a role's access to a route.
tool_grant_role_route_access: Grants a role access to a route.
tool_list_role_route_access_by_role: Lists the routes allowed for a role.
tool_list_role_route_access_user_roles: Lists the roles used in access control.
tool_remove_role_route_access_by_role: Removes every route permission from a role.
tool_remove_role_route_access: Removes a role's access to a route.
tool_get_system_configuration_by_key: Reads a global setting by key (secret values come masked).
tool_get_system_configuration: Reads a global setting by id (secret values come masked).
tool_get_user_configuration_definition_b: Reads a user setting definition by key.
tool_get_user_configuration_definition: Reads a user setting definition by id.
tool_get_my_configuration_by_key: Reads one of your settings by key.
tool_reset_all_my_configurations: Resets all your settings back to default.
tool_reset_my_configuration: Resets one of your settings back to default.
tool_check_my_route_access: Checks whether you can access a route.
tool_grant_user_route_access: Grants a user access to a route.
tool_list_user_route_access_by_user: Lists the routes allowed for a user.
tool_revoke_all_user_route_access: Removes every route permission from a user.
tool_revoke_user_route_access: Removes a user's access to a route.
tool_find_user: Finds a user by email, name or id.
tool_update_user: Updates a user's data (name, email, role, status).
tool_create_company_contact: Links a contact to a company.
tool_update_proposal: Updates a proposal's name or linked company.
tool_duplicate_proposal: Duplicates a proposal as a new draft.
tool_publish_proposal: Publishes a proposal, creating a new public version.
tool_reopen_proposal: Returns a proposal to draft and revokes its public version.
tool_revoke_proposal_publication: Revokes a proposal's current public version.
tool_accept_proposal_offline: Records a proposal's acceptance on the client's behalf.
tool_send_proposal: Sends a proposal to the client over WhatsApp.
userconfig_agent_provider_desc: Provider used by the agent in your conversations
userconfig_agent_base_url_desc: Required for OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio)
userconfig_agent_api_key_desc: Your personal API key for the agent
userconfig_agent_prompt_desc: Personal instructions concatenated to the global prompt in your conversations
storage_service_disabled_hint: Storage not configured — image upload unavailable
revokeConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to revoke this API key? This action is irreversible.
rawKeyWarning: This is the only time the full key will be displayed. Store it securely.
createDescription: Fill in the details below to create a new API key
secret_keep_blank: Leave blank to keep the current credential
connectorsUrlDescription: Paste this URL into your AI client. It registers itself and opens a screen for you to approve access — there is no key to copy and no config file to edit.
connectorsStepClaude: Claude Desktop: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
connectorsStepChatgpt: ChatGPT: Settings → Connectors → Create (remote MCP server).
connectorsStepPaste: Paste the URL above and confirm.
connectorsStepConsent: Sign in and pick which permissions the client gets.
connectorRevokeDescription: "{{client}}" loses access immediately. Reconnecting will require authorizing again.
connectDescription: {{client}} wants to access your account over MCP. It will be able to use the same agent tools you already have enabled, on your behalf.
connectScopesHint: Reading is always allowed. Check only the writes this client needs — you can revoke the whole connection later, in the Connectors tab.
connectSuccessDescription: Permissions approved. Continue to {{client}} to complete the connection.
tool_get_storage_config: Reads storage configuration and health (credentials are never exposed).
tool_save_storage_config: Changes storage configuration (S3 or local), validated against the provider.
tool_get_email_config: Reads email service configuration and health (credentials are never exposed).
tool_save_email_config: Changes email configuration (Resend or SMTP), validated against the provider.
tool_get_captcha_config: Reads captcha configuration and supported providers (the secret key is never exposed).
tool_save_captcha_config: Changes captcha credentials, validated against the provider.
tool_get_messaging_config: Reads WhatsApp connections and the health/session status of each one (credentials are never exposed).
tool_list_whatsapp_messages: Lists the WhatsApp message history, newest first.
tool_list_whatsapp_template_types: Lists the WhatsApp template types: variables and buttons defined for each.
tool_list_whatsapp_templates: Lists the WhatsApp templates in the catalog and the variables each one needs.
tool_create_whatsapp_template: Creates a WhatsApp template draft in the catalog (does not submit it for approval).
tool_submit_whatsapp_template: Submits a WhatsApp template draft for provider approval.
tool_send_whatsapp_message: Sends a free-text WhatsApp message to a phone number.
tool_send_whatsapp_template: Sends a WhatsApp template from the catalog with its variables filled in.
tool_list_capabilities: Lists the system's capabilities and their status (available/operational) for the user's role.
tool_list_my_notifications: Lists the logged-in user's notifications, with an optional unread-only filter.
tool_get_unread_notifications_count: Returns the number of unread notifications for the logged-in user.
tool_mark_notification_read: Marks one of the logged-in user's notifications as read.
tool_mark_all_notifications_read: Marks all of the logged-in user's notifications as read.
tool_dismiss_notification: Dismisses one of the logged-in user's notifications, removing it from the inbox.
tool_send_broadcast_notification: Sends a manual notification to all users or to specific roles.
tour_api_keys_intro: API keys work like unique passwords to integrate external programs, tools, or scripts with your account securely.
tour_api_keys_create: Click New API Key to generate a credential with a custom name, expiration date, and specific permissions (scopes).
tour_api_keys_table: Here you can monitor all active keys, their last used date, and revoke access immediately at any time.
tour_connectors_intro: MCP connectors allow external AI assistants (such as Claude Desktop or ChatGPT) to communicate with this platform securely.
tour_connectors_url: Copy this endpoint URL and paste it into your AI client to initiate a secure connection.
tour_connectors_instructions: Follow these simple steps to connect your smart assistant without needing complex configurations.
tour_connectors_list: Connected applications appear here. If you no longer want an app connected, simply click Revoke.
tour_agent_permissions_intro: Here you have full control over which actions the AI Agent can perform in the system on your behalf.
tour_agent_permissions_group: Filter permissions by category to view tools from a specific context.
tour_agent_permissions_switch: Use the toggle switches to enable or disable each tool individually according to your preference.
